Use case: historical-scene.

Create one brand-new native square RGBA sheet, exactly four equal cells arranged in a 2x2 grid, no printed labels or visible grid. No muzzle flash, smoke, extra weapon, captions, insignia badges, flags or additional people.

Do not stretch, mirror or simply rotate an existing 2D image. Render the actual requested direction in three dimensions. Whole transparent artwork output only.
